The "Get Intego ONE" Tile Is Missing or Won't Open in Your Intego X9 My Account
OCTOBER 6, 2026 AT 3:24 PM

Applies to: Intego X9 · Intego ONE

If you're logged in to your legacy Intego My Account and can't find the Get Intego ONE tile, or you click it and nothing happens, this guide walks through the most common causes and how to resolve each one.

First, confirm which Intego product you have

The self-service upgrade tile is currently only available to customers on these two legacy plans:

Mac Internet Security X9
Mac Premium Bundle X9

If you're on a different legacy product, such as VirusBarrier X9, Washing Machine, ContentBarrier, Internet Security X9 Dual Protection, or an older X7-generation plan, the Get Intego ONE tile won't appear on your account, because these plans aren't eligible to migrate to Intego ONE. If you'd like to move to Intego ONE, you'll need to purchase a new Intego ONE subscription separately.

Once you've done that, we recommend turning off auto-renewal on your legacy plan so it doesn't continue to renew alongside your new subscription. You can do this yourself from your legacy My Account, or contact Intego Support and we can also check whether you're eligible for a refund on your legacy plan.

Make sure you haven't already upgraded

If your subscription was already migrated to Intego ONE, whether by you or by a support agent, the Get Intego ONE tile won't show up anymore in your legacy My Account. That's expected, not an error.

Intego ONE has its own, separate My Account portal from the legacy one. If you've already upgraded:

Go to the Intego ONE My Account portal.
Sign in using the same e-mail and password you used for your legacy Intego account.
From there, you can manage your subscription and download the Intego ONE app.

If you're not sure whether you've already been upgraded, check your inbox for an upgrade confirmation e-mail, or contact Support to confirm your current plan.

Confirm your Mac meets the system requirements

Before starting the migration, make sure your Mac meets the minimum requirements for Intego ONE:

macOS 12.4 or later
Intel or Apple Silicon processor
8 GB of RAM (minimum)
2 GB of free storage
If you see the tile, but clicking it returns you to the dashboard

This is typically a browser display issue rather than an account problem. Try the following:

Make sure JavaScript is enabled in your browser. Open Safari, select Safari in the top-left corner of your screen, choose Settings, and go to the Security tab. Make sure the checkbox next to Enable JavaScript is ticked.
Make sure cookies aren't blocked in your browser. Open Safari, select Safari in the top-left corner of your screen, choose Settings, and go to the Privacy tab. Temporarily untick the checkbox next to Prevent cross-site tracking.
Temporarily disable any ad-blocker extensions, as these can interfere with the upgrade window loading.
Try again. If it still bounces back to the dashboard, try a different browser (for example, switch from Safari to Chrome or Firefox, or vice versa).
If the tile is missing entirely on an eligible plan

If you have a Mac Internet Security X9 or Mac Premium Bundle X9 plan and still don't see the tile, first check your plan's status in My Account:

If your account is active with auto-renewal on: Confirm you meet the system requirements above, then contact Intego Support. This may be a known display issue our development team is actively investigating, and a teammate can manually check your eligibility and complete the upgrade for you so you don't have to wait on a fix.
If auto-renewal is turned off but your plan hasn't expired yet: We recommend turning auto-renewal back on before migrating, so your coverage continues without interruption while you upgrade. You can do this from your legacy My Account under Billing & Invoices.
If your subscription has fully terminated (auto-renewal was off and your renewal date has already passed): Unfortunately, a terminated legacy plan can no longer be migrated to Intego ONE. You'll need to purchase a new Intego ONE subscription instead.
What happens after you upgrade

A few details to note once your upgrade goes through, whether you did it yourself or had our team help:

There's no fee for switching over. Your usual rate simply applies as normal on your next renewal date.
To sign in to your new Intego ONE account, use the same e-mail and password you've always used.
Installing Intego ONE automatically removes your legacy Intego applications. Personal Backup and Intego Privacy Protection VPN are not affected and remain installed.
Still need help?

If none of the steps above resolve the issue, submit a request and include:

Your account e-mail address
The exact name of your current Intego product (for example, Mac Internet Security X9, Mac Premium Bundle X9, or VirusBarrier X9)
A screenshot of your My Account overview page
The browser(s) you've tried, if the tile is visible but won't open
Your macOS version
